title: UnitPriceSpecification
description: The price asked for a given offer by the respective organization or person.

type.title: Type
type.description: The RDF type(s) of this item.

billingDuration.title: Billing Duration
billingDuration.description: Specifies for how long this price (or price component) will be billed. Can be used, for example, to model the contractual duration of a subscription or payment plan. Type can be either a Duration or a Number (in which case the unit of measurement, for example month, is specified by the unitCode property).

items.$comment: NOTE[mixed range]: QuantitativeValue [value-type]: QuantitativeValue -> StructuredValue -> Intangible -> Thing

billingIncrement.title: Billing Increment
billingIncrement.description: This property specifies the minimal quantity and rounding increment that will be the basis for the billing. The unit of measurement is specified by the unitCode property.

billingStart.title: Billing Start
billingStart.description: Specifies after how much time this price (or price component) becomes valid and billing starts. Can be used, for example, to model a price increase after the first year of a subscription. The unit of measurement is specified by the unitCode property.

priceComponentType.title: Price Component Type
priceComponentType.description: Identifies a price component (for example, a line item on an invoice), part of the total price for an offer.

priceType.title: Price Type
priceType.description: Defines the type of a price specified for an offered product, for example a list price, a (temporary) sale price or a manufacturer suggested retail price. If multiple prices are specified for an offer the [[priceType]] property can be used to identify the type of each such specified price. The value of priceType can be specified as a value from enumeration PriceTypeEnumeration or, a UN/EDIFACT 5387 code, or as a free form text string for price types that are not already predefined in PriceTypeEnumeration.

priceType_text.title: Price Type (text)
priceType_text.description: Defines the type of a price specified for an offered product, for example a list price, a (temporary) sale price or a manufacturer suggested retail price. If multiple prices are specified for an offer the [[priceType]] property can be used to identify the type of each such specified price. The value of priceType can be specified as a value from enumeration PriceTypeEnumeration or, a UN/EDIFACT 5387 code, or as a free form text string for price types that are not already predefined in PriceTypeEnumeration.

referenceQuantity.title: Reference Quantity
referenceQuantity.description: The reference quantity for which a certain price applies, e.g. 1 EUR per 4 kWh of electricity. This property is a replacement for unitOfMeasurement for the advanced cases where the price does not relate to a standard unit.

unitCode.title: Unit Code
unitCode.description: The unit of measurement given using the UN/CEFACT Common Code (3 characters) or a URL. Other codes than the UN/CEFACT Common Code may be used with a prefix followed by a colon.

unitText.title: Unit Text
unitText.description: A string or text indicating the unit of measurement. Useful if you cannot provide a standard unit code for unitCode.
